pricing.packsSubtitle: No subscription. Pack credits never expire.

items.q: How long does it take to generate a video?
items.a: The first draft is ready in minutes. Chat edits are applied in seconds.

items.q: Will my logo and screenshots be modified?
items.a: Never. Kinetik animates your assets with movement, zooms and masks, but never distorts, crops or regenerates them. Your brand stays intact.

Generating a video costs 10 credits, each chat edit costs 2 credits, and export costs 5 or 10 credits depending on duration and quality (half price when you export the same video again). Editing in the editor is free. Subscription credits are topped up every month and unused ones expire at the end of the month; pack credits never expire.

items.q: Can I use my own music?
items.a: Yes. Upload your file or choose from our royalty-free library. Kinetik detects the tempo and syncs the animations.
Yes. You can use your exports anywhere, including commercially. The free plan simply adds a watermark.
MP4 in 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 at 1080p. 4K is available on the Pro plan.
